title: Mission 4 — A doctor's visit in Liepāja
summary: You travel west to Liepāja for work and catch a cold. Visit doctor Agnese, describe your symptoms, and ask about medicine.
summary_lv: Tu dodies darba braucienā uz Liepāju un saaukstējies. Apmeklē ārsti Agnesi, apraksti simptomus un pajautā par zālēm.

scenes.title: Check in at reception
scenes.instruction: Tell doctor Agnese (acting as the front-desk nurse) you have an appointment.
scenes.instruction_lv: Pasaki Agnesei reģistratūrā, ka tev ir pieraksts.

scenes.title: Describe your symptoms
scenes.instruction: Tell Agnese what hurts and how long you have felt unwell.
scenes.instruction_lv: Pasaki Agnesei, kas sāp un cik ilgi tu jūties slikti.
target_phrases: Es jūtos slikti jau trīs dienas.

scenes.title: Ask about medicine
scenes.instruction: Ask Agnese whether you need medicine and how often to take it.
scenes.instruction_lv: Pajautā Agnesei, vai vajag zāles un cik bieži tās lietot.
